nodes.label: Domain Docs Consumption Contract
nodes.rationale: Requires engineering skills to read CONTEXT.md/CONTEXT-MAP.md and docs/adr/ before exploring, proceed silently when absent so /domain-modeling creates them lazily, and enforce glossary vocabulary consistency.

nodes.label: ADR Conflict Flagging Rule
nodes.rationale: Any proposal or output contradicting an existing ADR must be explicitly surfaced rather than silently overriding recorded architectural decisions.
